config.inputs: All R2 previous/current/next groups already selected by the frozen A3 maximum-SSE snapshot rule, including saved adjacent value groups
branches: one re-encode of actual FP32 affine decode without H
one re-encode of saved actual physical FP32 decode transformed again by source H32
config.observations: Original and re-encoded UINT8/FP16 payloads; directed one-ULP checks; required raw scale FP32/FP64 minus original stored scale; extrema and mean/SSE decode changes
config.ideal_fullrange_check: If codes contain 0 and 255, ideal real affine decode has extrema offset and offset+255*scale. Binary FP64 exactly represents half metadata times UINT8 and their sums in this bounded contract; its required raw scale recovers the stored half scale. Such a grid is mathematically fixed, not necessarily FP32-operation fixed.
config.scope: Selected-group operation evidence only; no prevalence, performance-filter, total-metadata causal decomposition, or model-KL claim
